original_inputs.purpose: Before-fix native Windows replacement-limit reproduction; source pins captured before candidate edits.

retained_failed_attempts.reason: The initially selected historical descriptor did not satisfy the existing legacy ABI admission policy. It was rejected; a genuine current Native AOT fixture was published into a new directory for replay checks.

visual_review.method: Lossless BMP-to-PNG conversion for inspection; original BMP retained.
visual_review.observed: Fixture HUD, red projection marker and floor visible without corruption.

review_corrections: The initial movement inequality included tick metadata; final verifier explicitly checks changed controller/camera matrices and horizontal displacement. All 32 retained baseline movements were independently checked from raw transforms.
limitations: Forty successful restores per GPU in one primitive fixture; not unlimited lifetime, whole-game or Alpha qualification.
Same native player/context and exact frames do not measure long-session memory growth or device-loss recovery.
Semantic movement and API operations; no physical input or listening qualification.
Audio is disabled in cycle fixtures. Preserved audio replay is an offline prefix check, not output-device audibility.
The world owner retains its separate 10,000-session identity budget; CoreCLR retained-context budgets are unchanged.
Counter saturation and deferred-before-initialization branch are source-reviewed, not exercised through billions of restores.
Existing exported compiled-menu tests preserve source-free same-process behavior; fresh-process complete-game continuation remains separate.
Elapsed time and frames-presented are execution records, not representative performance measurements.
